name: North Gate Outpost
summary: Mountaineers guard the road through North Gate Outpost, where Dun Morogh meets Loch Modan. Their patrols keep travelers safe from the beasts in the crags.

sections.title: Guards of the Pass
sections.body: Dwarven mountaineers guard the road through North Gate Pass. From North Gate Outpost, they keep the route clear of prowling beasts and watch travelers heading through the mountain tunnels into Loch Modan. The pass is Dun Morogh’s northeastern threshold, but its harsh weather and steep ravines make patrols dangerous. When a patrol goes missing or a predator threatens the road, the garrison calls on travelers to scout the surrounding ridges.

faq.q: What is North Gate Outpost used for?
aliases: why is north gate outpost here
faq.answer: North Gate Outpost gives the mountaineers a post from which to guard North Gate Pass, the northern road between Dun Morogh and Loch Modan. They keep the route open to trade and travel by driving back wild beasts.

faq.q: Where does the road through the pass lead?
aliases: where does north gate pass go
faq.answer: The road leads east through mountain tunnels into Loch Modan, or west toward Kharanos and Ironforge.

faq.q: Why do the mountaineers need help from travelers?
faq.answer: Territorial beasts prowl the snowy cliffs, and mountaineers have gone missing in the crags while hunting them. The garrison needs scouts to search for the missing mountaineers and learn their fates.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you can see the Mountaineers’ duty in the work of keeping the highland passes open through freezing weather and prowling predators.
As a gnome, you can lend your wits and marksmanship to help the dwarven garrison track down lost patrols.
